responsibility: This header declares the public entry point of GCC’s Andersen-style tree points-to solver. It places `solve_constraints` in the `pointer_analysis` namespace so the structalias analysis code can invoke the dedicated inclusion-based constraint-graph solver implemented in `pta-andersen.cc`, without exposing that file’s internal graph representation or optimization machinery.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface half of the pta-andersen pair: it is a minimal header that only declares `pointer_analysis::solve_constraints` behind include guards for use by other structalias code, while `pta-andersen.cc` contains the actual Andersen solver implementation and all internal graph/optimization details.
